name: @pipeworx/mcp-twelvedata

tools.name: time_series
tools.description: Twelve Data OHLC time series for a stock, forex, crypto, or ETF symbol. Requires symbol and interval (e.g. '1min', '1h', '1day'). Returns timestamped open/high/low/close + volume.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

outputsize.description: Number of data points to return (1–5000, default 30).

start_date.description: Optional start of range, "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".

end_date.description: Optional end of range, "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".

order.description: Sort order: "asc" or "desc" (default desc, newest first).

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Twelve Data real-time quote snapshot for a symbol: open, high, low, close, volume, 52-week range, exchange, currency. Use for a full current-day market snapshot.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

tools.name: price
tools.description: Twelve Data latest trade price for a single symbol (stock, forex, crypto, ETF). Returns a single numeric price field. Lightest endpoint for current-price lookups.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

tools.name: eod
tools.description: Twelve Data end-of-day closing quote for a symbol. Returns the last closing price, volume, and date. Use for daily settlement prices rather than intraday data.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

tools.name: exchange_rate
tools.description: Twelve Data live forex exchange rate for a currency pair symbol (e.g. 'EUR/USD'). Optional dp (decimal places) and timezone. Returns rate, timestamp, and pair identifiers.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

tools.name: currency_conversion
tools.description: Twelve Data real-time currency conversion: pass a forex pair symbol (e.g. 'EUR/USD') and an amount to get the converted value at the current exchange rate.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

amount.description: Amount in the base currency to convert.

tools.name: stocks
tools.description: Twelve Data reference list of all supported stock symbols with exchange and country metadata. Use to discover or validate tickers before querying price endpoints.

tools.name: forex_pairs
tools.description: Twelve Data reference list of all supported forex currency pairs (e.g. EUR/USD). Use to enumerate or validate pair symbols before querying exchange_rate or time_series.

tools.name: cryptocurrencies
tools.description: Twelve Data reference list of all supported cryptocurrency symbols with exchange metadata. Use to discover or validate crypto tickers before querying price endpoints.

tools.name: etfs
tools.description: Twelve Data reference list of supported ETF symbols (64,000+ listings worldwide) with exchange and country metadata — paged, default 200 rows, `count` is the total matched. Filter by symbol (e.g. "SPY"), country or exchange. Use to discover or validate ETF tickers before querying price endpoints. A stock ticker (e.g. "AAPL") is not an ETF and returns an empty list with `empty_reason: wrong_instrument_class` — use the stocks tool for those.

mic_code.description: Optional ISO 10383 market identifier code filter (e.g. "XNAS", "XLON").

country.description: Optional country filter — full name or alpha code (e.g. "Japan", "Germany", "United States", "US").

page.description: Page of the reference list (default 1). `count` in the response is the TOTAL matched; `data` is this page.

outputsize.description: Rows per page (default 200, max 5000). The unfiltered ETF list is 64,000+ rows, so narrow with symbol / country / exchange rather than raising this.

tools.name: indices
tools.description: Twelve Data reference list of supported market index symbols with exchange metadata — about 1,300 NON-US indices (e.g. N225 Nikkei 225, 000001 SSE Composite, NSEI Nifty 50), paged, default 200 rows. Filter by country (e.g. "Japan", "India", "China"), exchange or symbol. US indices (SPX, DJI, IXIC, NDX, VIX) are NOT in Twelve Data's reference list and quoting them requires a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key via _apiKey — a US filter here returns that refusal, not an empty list. Use to discover or validate index tickers before querying time_series.

symbol.description: Optional index symbol filter (e.g. "N225", "NSEI", "000001"). US symbols such as SPX/DJI/IXIC are not in this list — see the tool description.

country.description: Optional country filter, full name or alpha code (e.g. "Japan", "India", "China", "Germany"). "United States" returns a plan refusal, not rows.

mic_code.description: Optional ISO 10383 market identifier code filter (e.g. "XNAS", "XLON").

page.description: Page of the reference list (default 1). `count` in the response is the TOTAL matched; `data` is this page.

outputsize.description: Rows per page (default 200, max 5000). The unfiltered ETF list is 64,000+ rows, so narrow with symbol / country / exchange rather than raising this.

tools.name: technical_indicator
tools.description: Compute a technical indicator time series for a stock/forex/crypto symbol via Twelve Data — RSI, SMA, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands (bbands), ADX, ATR, Stochastic, CCI, and more. PREFER for "RSI(14) of AAPL", "50-day and 200-day SMA of TSLA", "MACD for BTC/USD", "Bollinger Bands of SPY". This is the right tool for ANY "RSI / SMA / EMA / MACD / moving average / technical indicator for <ticker>" question. Computes ONE indicator per call: if several are requested (e.g. "RSI and the 50-day and 200-day SMA"), call this once per indicator starting with the first — do NOT decline just because multiple indicators are asked for. Returns dated indicator values.

indicator.description: Indicator (lowercase): rsi, sma, ema, wma, dema, tema, macd, bbands, stoch, stochrsi, adx, atr, natr, cci, mom, roc, willr, obv, ad, vwap, aroon, mfi, sar, trix, ppo, kama.

symbol.description: Ticker/symbol. Stocks e.g. "AAPL", "MSFT"; forex "EUR/USD"; crypto "BTC/USD"; ETFs "SPY". Comma-separate for a batch (e.g. "AAPL,MSFT"). Market indices (SPX, N225, …) need a Grow-or-higher Twelve Data key passed via _apiKey — the shared key cannot quote them.

time_period.description: Look-back period in bars (e.g. 14 for RSI, 50 or 200 for SMA, 20 for bbands). Default varies by indicator.

series_type.description: Price series the indicator is computed on: close (default), open, high, low.

outputsize.description: Number of data points to return (1–5000, default 30).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-twelvedata forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the twelvedata pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
